title: Coefficient sections over pro-étale objects agree with global sections after pullback
statement:
Let $B$ be a scheme and use its small pro-étale site and universe convention [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring] and $\Lambda_Z=p_Z^*\Lambda$ the coefficient ring on each scheme $Z$ [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point, sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients]. For an object $u:V\to B$ of $B_{\mathrm{proét}}$, the forgetful functor identifies $V_{\mathrm{proét}}$ with the localized site $(B_{\mathrm{proét}})/V$: objects are $W\to V$ and coverings are the same families of weakly étale maps. Under this identification, the abelian inverse image $u^*_{\mathrm{Ab}}$ is restriction to that localized site. With the canonical coefficient isomorphism $\alpha_u:u^*_{\mathrm{Ab}}\Lambda_B\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda_V$ [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms], evaluation at the final object $V\to V$ gives a ring isomorphism
$$\theta_V:\Lambda_B(V)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma(V,\Lambda_V).$$

For every $B$-morphism $h:W\to V$ between objects of $B_{\mathrm{proét}}$ and $s\in\Lambda_B(V)$, these isomorphisms satisfy
$$h^\sharp(\theta_V(s))=\theta_W(\Lambda_B(h)(s)).$$
Here $h^\sharp$ is the section map $r\mapsto\alpha_h\circ h^*_{\mathrm{Ab}}r$ after the monoidal-unit identification, and $\Lambda_B(h)$ is ordinary sheaf restriction. If $m_{\theta_V(s)}$ denotes the endomorphism of the regular $\Lambda_V$-module given by multiplication by $\theta_V(s)$, then the module pullback [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback], under $h^*\Lambda_V\cong\Lambda_W$, sends it to $m_{\theta_W(\Lambda_B(h)(s))}$.

proof.text: Clause (1) of [lem-weil-proetale-weakly-etale-localization] identifies $V_{\mathrm{proét}}$ with $B_{\mathrm{proét}}/V$, including coverings, and makes every given $h:W\to V$ weakly étale. Clause (1) of [lem-sfb-proetale-object-inverse-image-restriction] identifies abelian and ring inverse image with restriction. This applies to [def-sfb-finite-upper-star]: it and [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image] are the same sheafified left Kan extension along base change. Only clause (1) is used; the auxiliary constant ring may be $\mathbf Z$.

proof.text: By [sk-def-sfb-coefficient-morphisms], for each of $f=u,w,h$ the map $\alpha_f$ is a ring-sheaf isomorphism and $\eta_f$ is the inverse-image unit followed by $f_*\alpha_f$; by Step 1 this unit is the one of [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], so $\eta_f=\eta^{\alpha_f}$ in the notation of [lem-sfb-localized-ring-mate-graph-evaluation]. Apply that node three times. (a) To $u$ with $R=\Lambda_B$, $S=\Lambda_V$, $\beta=\alpha_u$: final-object evaluation gives the ring isomorphism $\theta_V$, and its diagonal formula gives $\Lambda_V(\delta)\eta_{u,V}(s)=\theta_V(s)$. (b) To $w=u\circ h$ with $R=\Lambda_B$, $S=\Lambda_W$, $\beta=\alpha_w$: final-object evaluation gives $\theta_W$, and its graph formula with $T=V$, $U=(W\to W)$, $b=h$, so $\gamma_b=\gamma=(h,\mathrm{id}_W)$, gives $\Lambda_W(\gamma)\eta_{w,V}(s)=\theta_W(\Lambda_B(h)(s))$. (c) To $h:W\to V$ over the base $V$ with $R=\Lambda_V$, $S=\Lambda_W$, $\beta=\alpha_h$: for $r\in\Gamma(V,\Lambda_V)$ its unit formula at $T=V$, with $V\times_VW=W$ and $\operatorname{pr}_V=h$, gives $\eta_{h,V}(r)=(\bar\alpha_h)_{W/W}(\Lambda_V(h)(r))$, and its section-as-map formula identifies the right side with $h^\sharp(r)$. Thus $\eta_{h,V}=h^\sharp$ on global sections.

source.place: Tag 03CE (lemma-localize-given-products), adjunction via product and graph; restriction formula following Tag 00Y0 (definition-localize). Agent-formulated ring-sheaf mate specialization of these formulas, extracted from coefficient-sections-localization old Steps 2–4.

proof.text: Now [lem-sfb-coefficient-mate-diagonal-graph] equates the graph evaluation in Step 2 with $\eta_{h,V}$ applied to the diagonal evaluation there. Substituting the three formulas of Step 2 proves $\theta_W(\Lambda_B(h)(s))=h^\sharp(\theta_V(s))$. Both the diagonal and graph are retained, so $h$ need not be a monomorphism.

source.place: Displayed coefficient-mate composition identity and final paragraph on the canonical iterated-fibre-product comparison; agent-formulated diagonal/graph evaluation, extracted from coefficient-sections-localization old Step 5.

proof.text: Set $r=\theta_V(s)$, $R=h^{-1}_{\mathrm{Ab}}\Lambda_V$, $S=\Lambda_W$. By [def-sfb-module-upper-star] module pullback is $S\otimes_Rh^{-1}_{\mathrm{Ab}}(-)$ along $\alpha_h$. Restriction from Step 1 sends the regular module and $x\mapsto rx$ to $R$ and multiplication by $t=r|_W$, objectwise. Apply [lem-sfb-regular-scalar-extension-multiplication] to $\varphi=\alpha_h$: its normalized $q$ is the canonical $h^*\Lambda_V\cong\Lambda_W$, and it conjugates the pulled-back multiplication to $m_{\alpha_h(t)}$. Step 2 identifies $\alpha_h(t)=h^\sharp(r)$, and Step 3 identifies this with $\theta_W(\Lambda_B(h)(s))$, proving the last clause.
